description: Start or resume BAMF Bot setup for the signed-in person: the same ordered steps, progress and rewards as onboarding on bamf.ai. Returns each step with its status, how to run it here (ask, call a listed BAMF tool, or share web_url), the next step and time saved. Creates the person's creator space on first use if they just signed up from this app.

creator_id.description: Creator space to onboard. Defaults to the person's own.

name: bamf.get_onboarding
